**Finding: Deviation (medium)** — WARRANTY

- **What the document says:** § 5.1 warrants only that IBM will perform Services "using reasonable care and skill" and that it has corporate authority, plus a covenant to comply with laws applicable to IBM's own business. § 5.2 makes those the exclusive warranties, and § 5.4(c) provides all Materials and non-IBM items "AS IS, WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND."
- **Gap vs. playbook:** no conformance-to-documentation warranty for Deliverables/Materials, no no-malicious-code warranty, and no remedy (repair, replacement, re-performance or refund). The broad "AS IS" language would also swallow any conformance protection.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** inserted a new § 5.1(c) with a 90-day conformance and malicious-code warranty and an express repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy (at IBM's option), and prefaced § 5.4(c) with "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1" to preserve the express warranty.
- **Fallback flagged in the comment:** a shorter warranty period is negotiable provided the remedy stands.
